rules.quote: Avoid using the acronym unless you’re speaking to a specialist audience.
rules.specification: Do not use 'CALD' for general audiences; spell out or use 'multicultural communities'.
rules.violation_condition: using the acronym 'CALD' when not addressing a specialist audience
when: speaking to a general rather than specialist audience
rules.why: Specific, actionable instruction against using the acronym CALD (G-1, G-2).

rules.quote: When you specify a dual identity or other heritage as an adjective, connect the reference and the term ‘Australian’ with an en dash.
rules.violation_condition: a dual identity or heritage modifier used adjectivally with 'Australian' without an en dash (e.g. using a hyphen or space instead of an en dash)
when: a dual identity or heritage is specified as an adjective modifying Australian or community
rules.why: Punctuation rule specifically governing dual identity adjectives (G-2, E-1).
